title: Dual Zoren Prime
extract:
Dual Zoren Prime is the Primed counterpart of  Dual Zoren hatchets. In addition to being a direct upgrade, the user gains a burst of speed during a melee slide attack in midair. Dual Zoren Prime was released alongside  Lavos Prime and  Cedo Prime.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Slash damage.
Airborne Melee Slide Attack will boost the user's Movement Speed which lasts until landing.
Stance slot has  polarity, matches  Swirling Tiger stance.
Innate one  and two  polarities.

Notes

Trivia
Dual Zoren Prime's unique trait is a reference to Coptering, an advanced maneuver that significantly increased the user's forward momentum when performing a melee slide attack especially while in the air, and was commonly used with the Dual Zoren due to its fast attack speed. Coptering was effectively replaced by Bullet Jumping with the introduction of Parkour 2.0 in Update 17.0 (2015-07-31).
This weapon doesn't share the look with the  Scindo Prime, nor  Scindo heavy axes, like its predecessor  Dual Zoren did.
